Bash(PGPASSWORD='6LP0Ojegy7IUU6kaX9lLkmZRUiAdAUNOltWyL3LegfYGR6rPQtB4DUSVqjdA78ES' psql -h 107.155.75.50 -p 5986 -U postgres -d ionbec-new -c "
-- Get answers (options) for all questions in this set
SELECT ''Answers/Options:'' as info, a.id, a.question_id, a.answer, a.is_correct_answer, a.created_at 
FROM answers a 
JOIN questions q ON a.question_id = q.id 
WHERE q.item_id = 725 
ORDER BY q.id, a.id;

-- Check if there are any categories for this question set
SELECT ''Categories:'' as info, cq.question_id, c.name, c.description 
FROM category_question cq 
JOIN categories c ON cq.category_id = c.id 
JOIN questions q ON cq.question_id = q.id 
WHERE q.item_id = 725;

-- Check for any attempts on this question set
SELECT ''Attempts:'' as info, a.id, a.delivery_id, a.status, a.started_at, a.completed_at, a.score 
FROM attempts a 
WHERE a.item_id = 725 
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;

-- Check which deliveries/exams this question set is part of
SELECT ''Exam Items:'' as info, ei.id, ei.exam_id, e.name as exam_name, ei.item_id, ei.order as exam_order 
FROM exam_items ei 
JOIN exams e ON ei.exam_id = e.id 
WHERE ei.item_id = 725;

-- Check which clients this belongs to
SELECT ''Client Info:'' as info, c.id, c.name, c.email 
FROM clients c 
JOIN questions q ON c.id = q.client_id 
WHERE q.item_id = 725 
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email;
")

Bash(PGPASSWORD='6LP0Ojegy7IUU6kaX9lLkmZRUiAdAUNOltWyL3LegfYGR6rPQtB4DUSVqjdA78ES' psql -h 107.155.75.50 -p 5986 -U postgres -d ionbec-new -c "
-- Get the complete question set info
SELECT ''Question Set Info:'' as info, id, title, type, created_at FROM items WHERE id = 734;

-- Get question details
SELECT ''Question Info:'' as info, id, item_id, LEFT(question, 100) || ''...'' as question_preview, score, ""order"" FROM questions WHERE item_id = 734;

-- Get all answer options with correct indicator
SELECT ''Answer Options:'' as info, a.id, a.answer, a.is_correct_answer, 
       CASE WHEN a.is_correct_answer = true THEN ''✓ CORRECT'' ELSE ''✗ Incorrect'' END as status
FROM answers a 
JOIN questions q ON a.question_id = q.id 
WHERE q.item_id = 734 
ORDER BY a.id;
")

Bash(PGPASSWORD='6LP0Ojegy7IUU6kaX9lLkmZRUiAdAUNOltWyL3LegfYGR6rPQtB4DUSVqjdA78ES' psql -h 107.155.75.50 -p 5986 -U postgres -d ionbec-new -c "
-- Check if answers have hashes
SELECT ''New Question Answers'' as info, a.id, a.question_id, LEFT(a.answer, 50) || ''...'' as answer_preview, a.is_correct_answer, a.hash
FROM answers a 
JOIN questions q ON a.question_id = q.id 
JOIN items i ON q.item_id = i.id 
WHERE i.title = ''BE051125 - MCQ 60''
ORDER BY a.id;")

Bash(PGPASSWORD='6LP0Ojegy7IUU6kaX9lLkmZRUiAdAUNOltWyL3LegfYGR6rPQtB4DUSVqjdA78ES' psql -h 107.155.75.50 -p 5986 -U postgres -d ionbec-new -c "
SELECT ''Existing BE051125 Questions'' as info, i.id, i.title, i.client_id, c.name as client_name
FROM items i 
JOIN questions q ON i.id = q.item_id 
LEFT JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id 
WHERE i.title LIKE ''BE051125 - MCQ%'' 
GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.client_id, c.name
ORDER BY i.id
LIMIT 5;")
